clarvis.watch.minDurationSeconds.description: Tasks/commands/debug sessions shorter than this are tracked but never notified about.

clarvis.agent.maxStepsPerTask.description: Tool calls before the agent stops and asks whether to carry on. A run's first eight reads of the owner's skills don't count. A loop that never converges should not run up a bill unattended.

clarvis.ravis.credentialFile.markdownDescription: Desktop VS Code only: the file holding Clarvis's key for RAVIS on this Mac (the launcher's `.run/clarvis-ravis.token`), so this editor can run and follow Codex tasks. code-server gets the key from the launcher and doesn't need it. **Machine-scoped on purpose:** a project you open cannot point this anywhere.

clarvis.codex.model.markdownDescription: The Codex model a new Codex task runs, from those RAVIS lists for your ChatGPT plan. Empty uses the plan's default model. Choose it in the menu behind the bowtie beside the chat box; a task keeps the model it started with. **Your own settings only:** a project's settings never choose it.

clarvis.codex.effort.markdownDescription: How hard Codex thinks in a new task: one of the levels its model offers, such as `low`, `medium` or `high`. Empty uses that model's default. A bigger model or higher effort uses the ChatGPT plan's allowance faster. **Your own settings only.**

enumDescriptions: I decide whether you asked a question or gave me a job, and check before each step that changes anything.
The same, but without checking. For work you are happy to walk away from.
Answer and read only. Nothing gets changed, whatever you ask.
Work out what to do and write it down. No edits.
Treat everything as a job, and check before each step that changes anything.
clarvis.chat.mode.description: How much Clarvis is allowed to do. Chat and Plan cannot reach the agent at all — the code never calls it, rather than the prompt being asked not to.

enumDescriptions: Anthropic API with your own key. Best tool calling.
OpenRouter — one key, many models. Use "Clarvis: Choose Model" for the filtered list.
LM Studio on this machine. No key, nothing leaves it. Models are browsed and loaded in the app.
Ollama on this machine. No key, nothing leaves it. Models are pulled from a terminal.
Any other OpenAI-compatible server — llama.cpp, vLLM, LocalAI, or one on your network. Clarvis asks for the address.
clarvis.chat.provider.description: Which model provider to use. No Claude-subscription option: Anthropic does not permit third-party products to use claude.ai logins without prior approval.

clarvis.chat.model.description: Model name. Empty uses the provider's default. Run "Clarvis: Choose Model" for a picker — on OpenRouter it lists only models that can call tools.

enumDescriptions: Use the same provider as chat.
Anthropic API with your own key.
Any other OpenAI-compatible server. Clarvis asks for the address.
clarvis.agent.provider.description: Provider for writing code and running the agent. Empty follows the chat provider — set it to keep a cheap model for chat and a capable one for code.

clarvis.agent.model.description: Model for writing code and running the agent. Empty follows the chat model. Run "Clarvis: Models" to set it.

clarvis.chat.baseUrl.ollama.description: Override the Ollama endpoint. Empty means http://localhost:11434.
clarvis.chat.baseUrl.ollama.markdownDescription: Send Ollama requests somewhere other than the default. Leave empty unless you are pointing at your own server. **Machine-scoped on purpose:** a project you open cannot set this, because your API key travels with every request.

clarvis.chat.baseUrl.lmstudio.description: Override the LM Studio endpoint. Empty means http://localhost:1234.
clarvis.chat.baseUrl.lmstudio.markdownDescription: Send LM Studio requests somewhere other than the default. Leave empty unless you are pointing at your own server. **Machine-scoped on purpose:** a project you open cannot set this, because your API key travels with every request.

clarvis.chat.baseUrl.openai.description: Override the OpenAI endpoint, for a proxy or gateway. Empty means the official API.
clarvis.chat.baseUrl.openai.markdownDescription: Send OpenAI requests somewhere other than the default. Leave empty unless you are pointing at your own server. **Machine-scoped on purpose:** a project you open cannot set this, because your API key travels with every request.

clarvis.voice.enabled.description: Speak briefings, task outcomes and chat replies aloud. Off until you ask for it — a voice that surprises you once is a voice you disable forever. Clarvis offers to set it up once, on first run.

clarvis.voice.selectedVoice.description: Voice to speak with: 'curated:default' for the shipped voice, 'fish:<reference_id>' for a specific Fish Audio voice, or 'system' for the OS voice.

clarvis.voice.savedVoices.description: Fish Audio voices you have named, as { "name": "<reference_id>" }. Added by the voice picker when you paste an ID; delete one by removing its line here.

clarvis.voice.fishAudio.engine.description: Fish Audio TTS engine. Quality vs speed vs cost; the default is their current best model on a free developer tier.

clarvis.voice.dailyRequestCap.description: Fish Audio requests per day before dropping to the system voice. A butler should not run up a bill while you're at lunch. Zero means never — the system voice does everything.

clarvis.chat.baseUrl.anthropic.markdownDescription: Send Anthropic requests somewhere other than the default. Leave empty unless you are pointing at your own server. **Machine-scoped on purpose:** a project you open cannot set this, because your API key travels with every request.

clarvis.chat.baseUrl.openrouter.markdownDescription: Send OpenRouter requests somewhere other than the default. Leave empty unless you are pointing at your own server. **Machine-scoped on purpose:** a project you open cannot set this, because your API key travels with every request.

clarvis.chat.baseUrl.custom.description: Address of your own OpenAI-compatible server. Clarvis asks for this when you pick the Custom provider — you should not need to edit it here.
clarvis.chat.baseUrl.custom.markdownDescription: Address of your own OpenAI-compatible server. Clarvis asks for this when you pick the Custom provider — you should not need to edit it here. **Machine-scoped on purpose:** a project you open cannot set this. There is no API key on this provider, but every prompt, and every file the agent has read, travels to whatever address it names.

clarvis.voice.trimLongReplies.description: Keep spoken replies under about twenty seconds. A reply that would run longer is read aloud as its opening sentence and Clarvis's own closing line; the panel always shows the whole thing, and nothing is cut mid-sentence. Turn this off to hear every reply in full — replies of a minute or more have been measured, which is the reason this exists.

clarvis.model.tuneLocalLoads.description: Load LM Studio models with Clarvis's own settings rather than the app's defaults, warm them at startup, and unload them once nothing points at them. LM Studio reserves room for four answers at once; Clarvis asks for one at a time, and the rest is memory you are not using. When you switch a role to a hosted provider or to a different local model, the model Clarvis loaded is released instead of sitting idle until LM Studio's own timeout. It only ever unloads models it loaded itself, never touches a model you loaded yourself, never changes LM Studio's own settings, and does nothing on other providers.

clarvis.bridge.enabled.markdownDescription: Let NERVIS see what this window is doing. Off by default, and off means nothing is bound, nothing is registered and no timer runs — not a socket that refuses. Read-only: NERVIS can never approve a step, run a command or change a setting, because the Bridge has no route that could. **Machine-scoped on purpose:** a project you open cannot turn this on, because it decides which local file gets read and where its contents are sent.

clarvis.bridge.nervisUrl.markdownDescription: Where NERVIS is listening. 8790 is NERVIS's own default and the port its launcher assigns; change it only if you run NERVIS somewhere else. Loopback only for now — a non-loopback value is refused and the enrollment secret is never sent. **Machine-scoped on purpose:** a project you open cannot redirect the Bridge.

clarvis.bridge.enrollmentSecretPath.markdownDescription: Path to NERVIS's enrollment secret — the file beside its database, named like it with a .enrollment suffix. Reading it is how Clarvis proves it is you; the file's own permissions are the check, and it must be a regular file, mode 0600, not a symlink. Empty means the Bridge binds but never registers, and every read of it is refused. **Machine-scoped on purpose:** a project you open cannot choose which file this is.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In an untrusted folder Clarvis reads and answers, but never runs commands or edits files.
